Diesen Job melden The Opportunity Join Adobe's DVA Audio Team in Hamburg and work on the cutting edge of audio technology! This is an outstanding opportunity to join a group that transfers innovative audio tech from research into real-world applications. You will help build reliable and intuitive audio-related workflows for Premiere Pro, ensuring our users have a flawless and delightful experience. What You'll Do As a Quality Engineer, you will drive quality processes and ensure adequate test coverage of features. You will also engage with customers to coordinate and prioritize relevant feature requests and quality issues. Define test strategies for new features, determining what to cover manually and what to automate. Conduct detailed testing of new features, considering how editors will use them. This includes judgment on audio processing quality and fidelity. Perform cross-platform testing on macOS and Windows, including varying hardware configurations. Develop and manage test cases, scripts, and automated tests, including using the latest AI tools to build custom testing solutions. Write clear, reproducible bug reports with detailed steps, anticipated versus actual results, logs, and crash data. Verify fixes and perform regression testing before releases. Provide product feedback on quality and usability, contributing to release readiness decisions. Collaborate with departments outside of Engineering and work closely with our customers to capture feedback and diagnose issues. Own and drive quality related processes for the team What You Need To Succeed A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science or TV/Film/Media, or 3 years relevant practical experience in media or post-production. Proficiency with Adobe Premiere (or another non-linear editing application) and familiarity with video and audio tools. Understanding of real-world editorial workflows and performance factors. Genuine interest in audio workflows, applications and technology Curiosity and a desire to learn about new technologies for software engineering and the technology industry. Problem-solving skills with an attention to detail. Good communication skills.
